title: Becca S Probable NDE 23057
content: I was one of the first open-heart surgery cases. I remember rising out of my bed and seeing myself lying there. There was no noise and no sense of time. I didn't understanding why I was above myself and seeing myself lying there. I felt like I was in limbo. I also felt like this was such a very peaceful existence that I didn't want to go back. I remember an impression, not a voice, that communicated, 'There is something you have to do yet.' I was being gently, but firmly, pushed back. I remember almost everything exactly as it happened 48 years ago. I saw no angels, people, or relatives. I believe the impression was from 'God.' I had never had this type of experience before. I remember everything very vividly even though it was years ago. I will never forget the experience and it did affirm my faith in a higher being.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related. Experience associated with other S/P open-heart surgery
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe My body was in limbo, hovering over my body on the hospital bed. I saw myself lying there. All I know it was an impression, not a voice; there is something I have to do yet.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was gently but firmly pushed back; I did not understand.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was gently but firmly pushed back; I did not understand. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I believe there is a higher being.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: because of your experience? Yes I believe there is a higher being. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: ges occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Most people believed me, though at first I was reluctant to share my experience.
